finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base, pooled and donor advantage is excluded under both interval methods. Uniform advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling. Primary pooled performance is worse at zero only under writer resampling; all other primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantages remain unresolved under both methods. The residual pooled writer interval favors personal adaptation at zero without establishing the useful margin or surviving crossed resampling at zero; all other residual intervals include zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods. Raw sums retain useful base and pooled uncertainty under both methods and donor uncertainty only under crossed resampling. Raw base favors personal adaptation at zero only under writer resampling; other raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Previously selected model prose reflects suggestion supply and prior choices, not human-authored text or necessarily final retained wording. Sparse histories, transferred calibration-selected rank, shared human units, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, human-only language-learning claim, epoch/seed/corpus ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
